## Purpose
GitHub Actions CI configuration. Runs the project's test suite on every push to `main` and on all pull requests.

## Files
- `test.yml` — defines the `tests` workflow: checks out the repo on `ubuntu-latest`, installs Node 22, configures a dummy git identity (required because hook tests shell out to `git commit`), and runs `npm test`.

## Gotchas
- The global `git config user.email`/`user.name` step is load-bearing — hook tests invoke real `git` commands, which fail in CI without an identity. Don't remove it when editing the workflow.
